note: 35 new creature concepts for Artus to vote on, 19 November 2026. None repeats a species among the 65 Creature Book families, Ore Ant or the four concepts excluded in October (Thistle Hedgehog, Silver Pike, Maple Mantis, Seedpod Cricket). Each has three styles: A Storybook (natural painted animal, like the current creatures), B Elemental (the same animal with a strong glowing power), C Champion (an armoured, braver hero form).
